findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and zero test files; the app ships with no regression guard of its own and no scaffolding for future tests
findings.suggestion: Add vitest as a devDependency with a test script; the pure modules (format, table, components) need no DOM mocking and can be covered immediately

findings.issue: Missing-values-last-in-both-directions is enforced only by ignoring dir in the null branch of the comparator; a refactor to a 'cleaner' cmp * dir would silently put — rows first on descending sorts
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator for null keys in both directions plus tie stability, and aria-sort state transitions

findings.issue: speciesCards encodes the spec's trickiest data rule (drop IDs > 10000, dedupe, map default Pokémon to species name, sort by dex); a boundary or dedup regression would only surface on specific Pokémon
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with mixed entries: deoxys-normal, a Mega form (>10000), a duplicate, out-of-order IDs

findings.issue: Move-table grouping (per-version-group filtering, url+level dedup, method rank order, default game = highest order) is the densest logic in the repo and fully untested
findings.suggestion: Extract the grouping into a pure function taking moves + group name and unit-test it against a small fixture

findings.issue: Pagination slice math and Math.min(page, totalPages) clamping are untested; page=0, page=999 and the partial last page are classic off-by-one spots
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the filter+paginate pipeline (extract it from homePage) for boundary pages and an empty result set

findings.issue: Inline re-implementation of the ID-extraction regex duplicates idFromUrl (format.ts:13); the two copies can drift apart
findings.suggestion: Import idFromUrl and add a couple of unit tests for ID extraction from PokeAPI URLs

findings.issue: URL filter round-trip (omit empty/default params, reset page on filter change, silently clear unknown type/generation) has no tests; regressions here break bookmarkable URLs
findings.suggestion: Property-style tests on readFilters(filtersQuery(f)) === f for a table of filter combinations

findings.issue: Cache eviction of failed requests is one line that a cleanup refactor could drop, permanently caching a rejected promise after a transient API error
findings.suggestion: Unit-test get() with a mocked fetch: failure then success must not return the stale rejection

findings.issue: Pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber, collapseWhitespace, latestFlavorText, orMissing) are only covered indirectly by the external suite
findings.suggestion: Add cheap unit tests; latestFlavorText's 'last English entry' and \f collapsing are easy to get wrong after a refactor

findings.issue: Router error mapping (NotFoundError and URIError → not-found, others → error page) is untested; losing the URIError case crashes on malformed URLs
findings.suggestion: A few tests over a route table, or at least unit coverage of decodeURIComponent failure handling

summary: The agent wrote no tests, no test script and installed no test runner — app/ has zero regression protection of its own and relies entirely on the external acceptance suite. This hurts more than usual because the riskiest logic (sortable comparator, species mapping, pagination, move grouping, URL state, request cache) is all in small pure modules that would be trivial to cover with Vitest. The acceptance tests guard the behaviour today, but the first data-layer refactor will have no fast or in-repo safety net.

Alternate forms (>10000) leaking into Learned by / ability / type lists, or a deoxys-normal card linking to /pokemon/deoxys-normal instead of the species URL
Dropped or duplicated move rows after the url+level dedup changes, wrong default game (highest order), or Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor-then-alphabetical method order breaking
Off-by-one at page boundaries, page=0 or page beyond the last showing an empty 'Page n of m' view, or the last partial page losing a species
Default/empty params (type=, generation=, page=1) reappearing in the URL, filter changes not resetting page to 1, or unknown type/generation values no longer cleared
A rejected promise being cached forever after one transient 500, or in-flight dedup being lost so the same URL is fetched dozens of times per page
